name: Save Me
source:
You inherit an estate from a deceased granny, but moving into the luxurious house is not all you thought it would be. What horror awaits you?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你从已故祖母那里继承了一座庄园，然而搬进这栋豪华宅邸后的生活却远非你所想的那般美好。究竟有什么样的恐怖在等待着你？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
